description_ru: Короткая поездка в шотландский город, где дождь не помешал хорошему отдыху.
text:
Edinburgh is the capital of Scotland, and it is famous for its castle, its history and its weather. When we arrived, it was raining, and it rained for three days. But we did not mind.

On the first morning, we climbed up to the castle. It was windy and cold, but the view of the city was wonderful. In the afternoon, we went into a museum to get warm. We saw old swords, strange maps and a very big clock.

In the evening, we had dinner in a traditional pub. I tried a Scottish soup, and my brother ordered a plate of fish and potatoes. A man with a guitar played sad songs, and everybody sang together.

On the last day, the sun finally came out. We walked up a big hill behind the city, and we could see the sea. Edinburgh in the sun was even better than Edinburgh in the rain.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка между зубами, выдыхайте воздух без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».
Кончик языка поднят и не касается нёба, губы чуть округлены; не раскатистое русское «р».
Округлите губы, как для «у», и быстро раскройте; зубы не касаются губы, не «в».
